Repository audit and isolated tests; no live hardware acceptance, paid operations or production deployment.

## How to read this ledger

The [JSON](acceptance.json) is the versioned source of these summaries. Implementation and acceptance are deliberately separate. `implemented` means an identified source path exists and was reviewed, not that all hardware was accepted. `covered_by_tests` identifies an automated contract; it does not certify universal behavior. `pending_hardware` and `pending_product` stay open; `superseded` describes an obsolete design, not delivered functionality. Evidence paths identify the inspected boundaries; final CI run/head evidence belongs to the linked PR/issue. Historical field reports are not independently reproduced by this review.

CI verifies identities, preserved historical requirements, hashes, source paths and summary consistency—not the physical truth of a field report. A future `accepted_hardware` entry must name a redacted report, artifact hash, environment and date. Do not put credentials, raw device identities or unbounded private captures in the ledger.

Update acceptance.json, run `node tools/repository-check.mjs --write`, and review the generated diff. Machine-local progress notes and historical archives are not the authoritative status.

## Unfinished cross-cutting work

### ANDROID

**not_implemented.** Required Android unified-protocol reader/OMAPI/OTG product support is not delivered. Retired VPCD APK is not an implementation.

Acceptance needed: Define protocol/security/native permissions, implement and test on authorized devices; do not claim code from a README badge.

### ESIM_DELETE

**partial.** Current standard delete with retained notification is a transition, not the requested custom deletion behavior.

Acceptance needed: User explicitly requested this last and interactive. Design/review and authorize exact-card destructive tests separately.

### RECORDING

**not_implemented.** Recording is not delivered by current browser call controls; removal of an old UI stub is cleanup only.

Acceptance needed: Define explicit consent, storage/retention/security and lifecycle semantics, implement, then authorize real acceptance.

### INSTALLER_WAIT

**partial.** Go installers exist, but lifecycle waiting still includes bounded polling; event-driven/cancellation improvements and least-privilege architecture remain a separate work item.

Acceptance needed: Verify exact polling paths on Windows/macOS before changing them; retain bounded waits and error diagnostics.

### IDENTICAL_REINSERT

**needs_verification.** A SIM unplug/reinsert with identical observed USB/ICCID/owner between samples cannot be certified by ordinary snapshot tests.

Acceptance needed: Native event/generation evidence and narrowly timed real HIL on all supported platforms; report uncertainty when indistinguishable.

### INCIDENT_MM_CLOSE

**unresolved_cause.** Historical forced-close root cause remains unknown. Current Linux ModemManager access is private D-Bus, not an mmcli subprocess whose stderr can simply be recovered.

Acceptance needed: Collect bounded redacted evidence at the real current transport boundary when authorized; do not invent carrier/port causes from generic symptoms.

### INCIDENT_TOPOLOGY

**unresolved_cause.** Historical topology_invalid report did not identify the exact rejected field. It is not evidence of a newly reproduced current defect.

Acceptance needed: Reproduce with sanitized field-level validation evidence on the exact artifact/Agent generation.

### FORK_MAINTENANCE

**ongoing.** Large files and a maintained upstream fork create maintenance cost, not proof of functional failure.

Acceptance needed: Preserve pinned provenance, patch notices and regression tests; refactor only around independently tested ownership boundaries.
